method: For c columns, r rows, finished block side b and sashing width s, the interior width is c*b+(c-1)*s and the interior height is r*b+(r-1)*s. Border width d is added twice to each dimension. Vertical sashing pieces are s by b and number r*(c-1); horizontal pieces are interior-width by s and number r-1. Zero-width sashing and borders have zero piece counts. Side borders are d by interior-height; top and bottom borders are quilt-width by d, giving a simple butt-jointed border plan. Checkerboard colors alternate by row plus column parity; alternate-row colors use row parity. Conversions use exactly 2.54 cm per inch. All sizes are finished dimensions and exclude seam allowance.
